reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset and Brown read daughter of Omri as granddaughter, a loose ancient idiom marking her descent from Omri's idolatrous line through her father Ahab.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells presses the plain wording: Kings and Chronicles name Omri as Athaliah's father in one place and Ahab in another, and one man cannot be both.

sides.snippet: for he had the daughter of Ahab as wife
sides.verseText: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab as wife; and he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahweh.

sides.snippet: His mother's name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel.
sides.verseText: Twenty-two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel.
